function.name: Read
function.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem. Usage:
- The file_path parameter must be an absolute path, not a relative path
- You can optionally specify a line offset and limit (especially handy for long files)
<example>Read(file_path="/ws/a.txt")</example>
Don't read binary files & don't guess paths.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from

limit.description: The number of lines to read

function.name: Edit
function.description: Performs exact string replacements in files. The edit will FAIL if `old_string` is not unique — provide more context. Größe & Übersicht: <system-reminder> tags are not part of the file.
